verdict.rationale: The SOS documents that customers can print plain copies of their business entity filings online and that bulk data files are available to requestors, which gives a thin, first-party way to get entity records out. Neither is shown to be a complete export of a user's data, and no file format is stated, open or otherwise. missing for 10: a documented full export of all of a user's account/entity data, explicit open machine-readable formats (e.g., CSV/JSON), documented account closure or offboarding, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Customers can print plain copies of business entity documents online at bizfileOnline.sos.ca.gov including formation/registration, amendments, terminations and statements of information.
Free online access to over 17 million corporate, limited liability company and limited partnership images is available online
If you are a requestor of Bulk data, the new entity numbers will be reflected in the files.
